correctness.rationale: Every edge on a shortest terminal u–v path has forward distance potential φ(b)−φ(a)=ell_ab and the oriented graph is a terminal DAG. In the positive cap s=L−f(v)∈[0,eps], z_x=φ(x)−f(x), each edge becomes 0≤z_b−z_a≤2ell_ab. Every vertex lies on a directed u–v path, so 0≤z_x≤s; eps≤2ell_* makes all upper bounds automatic. At fixed s the internal coordinate set is exactly s times the reachability order polytope, with anchored Jacobian one; Stanley’s volume=e(P)/(N−2)! integrates to each cap e(P)eps^(N−1)/(N−1)!, doubled by central symmetry. For an isolate-free height-two poset, H_P edges u–A–B–v realize every relation and have terminal distance and graph diameter exactly 3; no-isolates ensures all edges lie on length-three terminal geodesics. eps=1 recovers 2e(P)/(n+1)! and polynomial time counting reduction from Dittmer–Pak #H2LE. Finite rational tests corroborate rather than prove the exact all-graph identity.
